manifest_metadata.audit_verdict: REMEDIATION JUSTIFIED — BOUNDED REMEDIATION PLAN PROPOSED

cause_1_unmasked_conv2d_bleed.description: AstroVisionAutoencoder passes unmasked images directly to standard Conv2d, allowing fatal flagged pixels (saturated stars, cosmic rays up to 75,000 MJy/sr) to corrupt latent representations and contaminate central unflagged sky pixels.
cause_1_unmasked_conv2d_bleed.key_evidence: PILOT_001118: pixel (93, 53) has flux 75,035 MJy/sr (flag 2097217, fatal=True). Center pixel has true flux 0.095 MJy/sr, but recon outputs 6.57 MJy/sr, generating chi2=409,866 on clean sky.

cause_2_no_background_normalization.description: Autoencoder was trained on raw non-zero-centered surface brightness (P0001, P0002). In low-zodiacal fields (P0010 NEP), background drops by 3.1x, creating massive DC reconstruction offset and score elevation on empty sky.
cause_2_no_background_normalization.key_evidence: D1 median flux drops from 0.4262 (P0008) to 0.1370 (P0010); D4 drops from 0.2307 to 0.0830. In P0010, control median chi2 (125.37) exceeds extended injection median (120.01).

cause_3_peak_chi2_scoring_mismatch.description: Using single peak-pixel chi2 as the benchmark score severely discriminates against diffuse extended sources whose flux is dispersed across 30-50 pixels.
cause_3_peak_chi2_scoring_mismatch.key_evidence: Extended AUROC using model_target_peak_chi2 is 0.5704, but using differential_residual_flux is 0.9700.

cause_4_shot_variance_damping.description: Physical injection engine adds Poisson variance to inj_var, inflating the denominator of (I - I_hat)^2 / Var in diffuse regions and lowering normalized chi2 below null controls.
cause_4_shot_variance_damping.key_evidence: D4 extended injections have lower median chi2 (154.42) than null controls (283.80).

cause_5_static_scalar_threshold_transfer.description: A single static scalar threshold tau_d fitted on two pointings cannot generalize across heterogeneous zodiacal backgrounds, leading to empirical FPR inflation from 5.6% to 8.6% (p=6.39e-4).
cause_5_static_scalar_threshold_transfer.key_evidence: D1 control 95th percentile in evaluation is 2,714.90 vs tau_d=399.04, driving D1 eval FPR to 19.05%.

cause_6_sample_starvation_in_training.description: Spatial autoencoder was trained on only 80 clean cutouts from 16 files, providing inadequate diversity across detectors and sky coordinates.
cause_6_sample_starvation_in_training.key_evidence: Dataset had only 80 training patches and 60 validation patches.

cause_7_hardware_or_pipeline_defect_in_d.description: D4 failure is caused by broken hardware or corrupt FITS pipeline data.
cause_7_hardware_or_pipeline_defect_in_d.key_evidence: FITS files for D4 are standard Level-2 products with valid WCS, expected background, and clean images; failure is algorithmic.

cause_8_p0010_high_fpr.description: Pointing 0010 suffers from excessive false alarms.
cause_8_p0010_high_fpr.key_evidence: P0010 had the lowest FPR (4.88%) of all pointings; its failure is loss of signal contrast (score inversion).

priority_1_mask_aware_convolutions.action: Replace standard Conv2d with Partial Convolution (PConv) or MaskAwareConvBlock to prevent masked pixels from polluting the latent space.

priority_2_local_background_normalizatio.action: Implement Local Adaptive Noise Scaling (LANS) or zero-centered background subtraction (I - median(I)) prior to model input.

priority_3_aperture_integrated_scoring.action: Adopt aperture-integrated chi2 or differential residual flux as detection score for extended sources.

priority_4_quantile_regression_calibrati.action: Replace fixed tau_d with local-background conditioned quantile thresholding tau_d(bg, var).

priority_5_stratified_retraining.action: Retrain ASTROVISION on an expanded, stratified multi-pointing dataset covering ecliptic and polar fields.

final_decision: LIMITED REMEDIATION JUSTIFIED — Proceed to a strictly bounded remediation task (Task 1.1U) targeting algorithmic pre-processing, mask-aware inference, and aperture scoring before November 10 milestone.
